newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RBNZ forecasts assume Trade Weighted Index at 66.5.
newsitem.headline: RBNZ forecasts assume Trade Weighted Index at 66.5.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand said on Tuesday that inflation forecasts in its six- monthly monetary policy statement assume the New Zealand dollar Trade-Weighted Index (TWI) will average 66.5 over the three-year forecast period.
In September, the bank's forecasts had assumed the TWI would average 65.0 over the forecast period.
The TWI was 66.69 at 7.00 a.m. (1900 GMT) on Tuesday morning.
The bank said its assumptions included 90 day interest rates at nine percent.

"Broadly speaking the effect of a TWI level about two percent lower (i.e. around 65.2) would be approximately offset by a 90 day rate about 100 basis points higher (i.e. around 10 percent)," the bank said.
